summary: Motion blur on moving things (camera optional) and rain wetness on every outdoor surface.
rationale: Both changes are appearance: a matched pair for each, cropped 1:1 where the difference shows (a spinning tail rotor; a tank's paint and canvas in the rain). Motion blur is also motion, but a still at the exact frame shows the blur itself; the LOD cross-fade is described in text because a dissolve between two distant meshes doesn't read in a still.

capture.renderer: Forward+ (Vulkan), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, 1600x900, off-screen window, --preset=ultra
capture.rain: --scenario=roster --seed=3 --mood=rain --focus=-84,24 --zoom=24 --shot-at=6; before from origin/main, now from this branch; crop 700,300-1500,750
capture.note: All runs use --fixed-fps 30. Before and now share the seed and moment, but the battle can differ slightly run to run.
